info.name: GuildChat API
info.description:
Every endpoint served by internal/router/router.go, and nothing else.

HOW TO RUN
Set baseUrl, then run the whole collection in order. Folder 01 registers three
accounts and stores their tokens, and every id after that is captured from a
response. Nothing needs to be pasted by hand, and the run repeats against the
same database because each run stamps a fresh runId into the usernames.

THE THREE FIXTURE ACCOUNTS
  A  owns the room and drives most flows          -> authToken, userId
  B  friend, DM partner, plain room member        -> tokenB,    otherUserId
  C  never joins anything, drives the 403s/404s   -> tokenC,    thirdUserId

STRUCTURE
  00-06  one folder per resource, in dependency order, each request documented
  07     failure paths, grouped by the kind of failure
  08     self-contained workflows; any one of these folders runs on its own

WHAT THE TESTS ASSERT
Status codes, response shape, that ids and embedded users are the right ones,
that error bodies explain the right failure, and that mutations actually
changed state when read back. Not just 200.

KNOWN BACKEND BUG PINNED HERE
"Send a friend request to an unknown user" asserts 500, which is what the
backend currently returns. Every comparable endpoint answers 404. See that
request's description.

request.description: Set up for the reject path.

Reject DELETEs the row rather than storing a rejected status, so RETURNING hands back the row as it stood, still pending. The repository then overwrites the status to rejected before returning, which is why the response says rejected while nothing with that status exists in the table. Because the row is gone, a fresh request between the same pair is allowed afterwards.
